name: AI Coding Agent Audit
summary: An audit trail of what AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Gemini CLI, Cursor and GitHub Copilot) do on a host: every shell command, file change, web fetch, MCP call, subagent and session, recorded by a hook (managed hooks or system settings for each agent; opencode: a plugin) before it runs (Cursor: right after), with secrets in command lines replaced by ***. Graded rules for destructive commands (locally and over SSH), reading private keys and credential files, download-and-run, an agent changing its own permissions and hooks, sessions with all permission prompts off, and tampering with the audit itself. An inventory script finds AI coding agents on hosts the audit does not cover and local model servers (Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM) listening on the network.
summary_zh: AI 程式代理（Claude Code、Codex、opencode、Gemini CLI、Cursor、GitHub Copilot）在主機上做了什麼的稽核記錄：每一個 shell 指令、檔案變更、網頁讀取、MCP 呼叫、子代理與工作階段，都在執行前由 hook 記下（各代理用受管理的 hooks 或系統設定，opencode 用外掛；Cursor 是執行後立即記下），指令裡的密碼與 token 先換成 ***。分級規則涵蓋：破壞性指令（本機與經 SSH）、讀取私鑰與帳密檔、下載後直接執行、代理修改自己的權限與 hook、關閉所有權限確認的工作階段，以及竄改稽核本身。盤點腳本會找出稽核沒有涵蓋的主機上的 AI 程式代理，以及在網路上開放的本機模型服務（Ollama、llama.cpp、vLLM）。
author: Jason Tools
notes: What is recorded: who (OS user, session id, subagent), where (host, working directory, permission mode) and what (the tool; for shell commands the command line, up to 2,000 characters; for file tools the path; for web tools the address). Never file contents, command output or prompts.

Secrets: the hook replaces passwords, tokens and keys in command lines before anything is written (variables such as DB_PASSWORD=, options such as --password and -p of mysql, user:password in URLs and curl -u, Authorization and Cookie headers, private key blocks, and the GitHub, GitLab, Slack, AWS, Google and JWT token formats). It cannot know every program's syntax: a secret written into a heredoc or a positional argument may stay. Treat the log and the alerts as sensitive.
The hook runs before the call (PreToolUse), so calls that were then refused by the user or the permission system are recorded too: the alerts are attempts.
The hook never blocks anything: it prints nothing, exits 0, gives up silently on any error, and does nothing on a host where /var/log/jt-ai-agent/actions.log does not exist.

Make it mandatory through the managed settings (/etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json): hooks there cannot be turned off by users, also not with disableAllHooks. A user's own ~/.claude/settings.json works for one user but that user can remove it.

The log is writable by every local user (mode 0622) so that agents running as ordinary users can write to it. A local user can therefore append forged lines; what Wazuh has already read stays in Wazuh. Changes to the hook and the managed settings are reported by file integrity (133722, 133723).

Rules match the plain, common forms of risky commands; a command can always be written so that a pattern misses it. The level-3 record of every command is the part that cannot be avoided as long as the hook runs.
Agents without a hook (Aider, Windsurf, Cline, Continue, local models run directly ...) are not covered; any tool that writes the same JSON line to the log is read the same way.

1.1: Codex and opencode. The hook takes --agent codex|opencode and maps their tool names to Claude Code's (Codex apply_patch becomes Edit, or Write when it only adds files, with the patched paths and never the patch text; opencode's bash/read/write/edit become Bash/Read/Write/Edit), so the same rules cover all three and jt_ai.agent says which one it was; the original name is kept in jt_ai.tool_raw. Codex calls it as a managed hook from /etc/codex/requirements.toml, opencode through the pack's plugin in /etc/opencode/plugins/. Changing Codex or opencode settings and plugins counts as an agent changing its own settings (133713/133714, which also catch codex started with --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust or --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox), and /etc/codex and the opencode plugin are part of the audit's tamper rules and file integrity. Codex's hosted web search does not reach PreToolUse, so it is not recorded.

1.2: who and where (real_user from sudo, login_user, ssh_from, the git repo and branch), permission requests (133736), failed calls (133737), session ends, MCP server and tool split out (mcp_server, mcp_tool), credentials removed from a command flagged (133735). New behaviour rules: uploading a local file with curl or wget (133724), file-sharing, tunnel and out-of-band services (133725), raw sockets (133726), cloud, registry and other agents' credentials (133727, 133728), .env files (133729, L5), persistence by cron, systemd, shell start-up files or authorized_keys (133730, 133731), clearing history or logs and turning off auditing or a security control (133732, L12), accounts and privileges (133733, 133740), --no-verify (133734), a session driven over SSH from a public address (133738). Permission requests and failures go to a level 0 rule first, so they never fire the detection rules a second time. macOS support (Darwin block in the agent group).

1.3: Gemini CLI, Cursor and GitHub Copilot. The hook takes --agent gemini|cursor|copilot and maps their payloads and tool names to Claude Code's (Gemini run_shell_command/read_file/write_file/replace become Bash/Read/Write/Edit, MCP tools mcp_<server>_<tool> become mcp__<server>__<tool>; Cursor Shell becomes Bash and MCP:<tool> an mcp__ name; Copilot bash/view/create/edit become Bash/Read/Write/Edit). Gemini CLI: hooks in the system settings /etc/gemini-cli/settings.json (macOS /Library/Application Support/GeminiCli/), which override user and project settings (except hooksConfig.disabled, see 1.5.3). Cursor: enterprise hooks /etc/cursor/hooks.json (macOS /Library/Application Support/Cursor/hooks.json); Cursor's before-hooks are permission hooks that block the call on a wrong answer, so the pack uses postToolUse and postToolUseFailure: every Cursor call is one PostToolUse line written right after it ran, and a refused or failed call carries failed and error, so the detection rules also see refused attempts. Copilot (Copilot CLI; GitHub does not document whether VS Code's agent mode reads policy.d, so check it there): policy hooks /etc/github-copilot/policy.d/jt-ai-agent.json; Copilot denies a preToolUse call when the hook fails, so the command ends with exit 0, and for these three agents the hook always prints {} (no decision). VS Code's deprecated Local harness reads no system-wide hooks and is not covered. The user's email that Cursor reports is kept as jt_ai.account. New: changing Gemini, Cursor, Copilot or repository hook settings counts as the agent changing its own settings (133713/133714, which also catch gemini --yolo, copilot --allow-all-tools and cursor-agent --force), VS Code settings changed by an agent (133741, L6: auto-approve can be turned on there, CVE-2025-53773) or the auto-approve key touched from a shell (133742, L8), the Gemini, Copilot and Cursor login files count as credentials (133727/133728), and Cursor's Delete tool counts as a file change.

1.4: sequences within one session (jt_ai.session): reading credentials (133711, 133715, 133727-133729) and then uploading a file or using a tunnel or file-sharing service within 15 minutes is level 13 (133745), the shape of exfiltration by a prompt-injected agent; four or more destructive commands within ten minutes is level 12 (133746), a runaway session. A line without a session id never correlates. More tunnel services in 133725 (localhost.run, serveo, pinggy, bore, localtunnel). Add daily_groups = ai_agent in jt-alert-digest.conf for one part a day in the daily summary. Inventory (jt-ai-agent-inventory.py, every six hours on every manager node): from syscollector's packages, processes and listening ports and the file integrity database, a coding agent on a host outside the group ai-agent is level 8 (133751), a host in the group without the hook level 7 (133752), Aider (no hook mechanism) level 5 (133753), a local model server level 3 (133754) and one listening on a non-loopback address level 8 (133755): Ollama and llama.cpp's server have no authentication by default. Each finding is reported once, reminded weekly and reported again when it is gone (133756). A package is found as soon as syscollector's next package scan; a process only while it runs at the hourly process scan.

1.4.1: inventory fixes from the first production run: listening ports were never matched to their process (wazuh-db names the column PID in sys_ports); processes of unprivileged LXC containers (user 100000 and up), which a Proxmox host lists as its own, are skipped; Ollama's own llama-server runner is not reported as a separate llama.cpp server; vLLM's engine process (VLLM::EngineCore) is recognised. 133754 no longer says the server listens on loopback, since a package alone is enough for it.

1.5: browser automation through MCP (Claude in Chrome, Playwright MCP, Chrome DevTools MCP, Puppeteer MCP): the hook records the action (navigate, click, type, fill, screenshot, read, evaluate, upload, network, console, tabs), the address, the tab and the element as jt_ai.browser_action, url, tab and element; what was typed or filled in and the JavaScript only by length (text_len, js_len). Rules: every browser action L3 (133747), JavaScript in a page L6 (133748), the browser's network requests or cookies L6 (133749), a password or one-time-code field L5 (133758), a local file uploaded L8 (133759, and the end of a credentials-then-upload sequence, 133745 L13), an internal or administration page opened L4 (133760; loopback addresses do not count) and JavaScript or a password typed after it in the same session L8 (133761). Also: an agent changing its MCP servers (133762 command, 133763 file, L8), reading a browser's cookies or saved passwords (133765, L10), network scanners (133768, L6), cryptocurrency miners (133769, L10), CI/CD pipelines changed (133770, L5), screen capture or clipboard reads from a shell (133771, L5), a new git remote or a push to an address on the command line (133772, L6), the Wazuh agent's own configuration under /var/ossec/etc or /Library/Ossec/etc counts as tampering with the audit (133720/133721, L12), and starting Claude Code with all permission prompts off counts with the other agents (133714). The parameter shapes come from the tools' documentation; none of these tools has been used on an audited host yet.

1.5.1: 133720 (L12) matched any command that mentioned /var/ossec/etc, so an agent writing documentation in a heredoc, creating another file there, or administering a manager over SSH raised a level 12 alert (seen in production the first day). Shell changes to the Wazuh agent's own ossec.conf, local_internal_options.conf or client.keys on this host are now 133773 (L10), not in a heredoc and not over ssh; the Edit and Write tools on those files stay 133721 (L12).

1.5.2: opencode names an MCP tool <server>_<tool>, not mcp__<server>__<tool>, so its MCP calls were recorded under the bare name and matched no rule. The hook now reads the server names from opencode's configuration (the managed and user opencode.json/jsonc, OPENCODE_CONFIG and the project's) and records these calls as mcp__<server>__<tool> with mcp_server and mcp_tool, like Claude Code's (133707). opencode 2.x Code Mode (the execute tool: JavaScript that calls MCP tools and makes HTTP requests) is recorded as CodeMode with the script's length only (133774, L3); each tool it calls is recorded on its own line. Dashboard: a chart beside the tables of agents, AI agents, events, tools, hosts, accounts, SSH destinations and MCP servers, and the description in Top rules is now the one for that row's AI agent.

1.5.3: Gemini CLI merges hooksConfig.disabled from the user's and the project's settings into the system list (merge strategy UNION), so a user can turn the audit hook off with /hooks disable or by editing ~/.gemini/settings.json or <project>/.gemini/settings.json. Whenever an audited session starts (any agent), the hook reads those two files and, when the hook is disabled there or hooks are switched off, records which file and which setting (jt_ai.gemini_hook_off; nothing else from the file, which can hold MCP servers' tokens): rule 133775, L10. A project file is only seen when a session starts in that project or below it. Copilot: GitHub does not document whether VS Code's agent mode reads policy.d; check it there before relying on it.

1.5.4: the inventory (jt-ai-agent-inventory.py 1.1) closes the gap for people who use only Gemini: it remembers from the node's alerts when each agent was last heard from on each host, and a Gemini CLI, Claude Code or Codex process started in the last 24 hours on a host in the group, with the hook installed, that has sent nothing since it started is rule 133776 (L7). Long-running idle servers (opencode serve) and the Cursor app, which log only once they are used, are not judged.

1.6: users' prompts can be recorded, off unless the server turns it on: the setting "prompts" in the agent group's jt-ai-agent.conf (this pack's Settings in jt-wazuh-mgr) is off, local (the prompt, secrets removed, stays on the host in /var/log/jt-ai-agent/prompts.log, root only; the audit line carries its length and a hash) or wazuh (also the first 2,000 characters in the audit line). The manager delivers the file to every host of the group; a root cron job (jt-ai-agent-hook.py --sync-config, every five minutes) copies it to /etc/jt-ai-agent/config for the users' hooks and records each change (rule 133779, L5). Rules 133777 (a prompt, L3) and 133778 (a password or token pasted into a prompt, L8: it has gone to the AI provider). Claude Code (UserPromptSubmit), Codex (UserPromptSubmit), Gemini CLI (BeforeAgent) and Copilot (userPromptSubmitted); Cursor's prompt hook can block the prompt and is left out, opencode is not covered yet.

1.6 (Windows, BETA): a PowerShell hook (jt-ai-agent-hook.ps1, Windows PowerShell 5.1, no other software) and an installer (jt-ai-agent-install.ps1) for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor and GitHub Copilot on Windows, including prompt recording; the lines carry "platform":"windows" and "hook":"ps1-beta". Tested on Windows 11 with Windows PowerShell 5.1 by feeding each agent's documented hook input; not yet run inside real agent sessions on Windows (Codex's and Copilot's Windows hook support in particular follows their documentation and source). Each call starts PowerShell, about one to two seconds. opencode on Windows is not covered. Windows-specific rules: 133780 (the hook, logs, scheduled task or managed settings changed from a command, L12), 133781 (event logs cleared, Defender, auditing, firewall or backups turned off, L12), 133782 (persistence: scheduled task, service, Run key, Startup folder, WMI, PowerShell profile, L10), 133783 (local users and groups, UAC, L10); 133712 (destructive) and 133715 (credentials) also read Windows commands, and 133721 to 133723 the Windows paths. The inventory does not judge Windows hosts yet (no hook_missing or silent for them).

1.6.1: both hooks read the JT_AI_AGENT_LOG, JT_AI_AGENT_PROMPT_LOG and JT_AI_AGENT_CONFIG variables only when they are not the installed copy (/usr/local/lib/jt-ai-agent, C:\Program Files\jt-ai-agent) that the agents' managed settings run: the hook runs as the user, who could otherwise turn prompt recording off or send the audit to a file of their own without anything being logged. The Windows hook and installer take the ProgramData and Program Files folders from Windows, not from the environment variables of the same names. Fields that come from the user's environment by nature (the user before sudo, the SSH source address) are only as trustworthy as that environment. The macOS step for prompts names the newsyslog file.

1.6.2 (Windows, BETA): the installer takes -Agents (only the named agents) and -Prompts (the prompt setting where the manager does not deliver one); jt-ai-agent-uninstall.ps1 and jt-ai-agent-check.ps1 added. VS Code's GitHub Copilot uses the same runtime and hook format as Copilot CLI and loads the machine-wide policy hooks in C:\ProgramData\GitHub\Copilot\policy.d, which, as GitHub documents, a user cannot turn off with disableAllHooks; hooks in VS Code are a preview feature and this has not yet been run in VS Code itself. VS Code's enterprise policies ChatAllowManagedHooksOnly and ChatApprovedAccountOrganizations go with it. Visual Studio (not VS Code) and JetBrains are not documented to support Copilot hooks.

1.6.3: the hook also records what ssh runs on the other host (jt_ai.remote_cmd, secrets removed), and rule 133716 (a destructive command sent to another host, L12) requires the destructive pattern there: on "ssh host 'systemctl start x'; shred -u key" the shred runs here and stays 133712 (L10). A hook older than 1.6.3 sends no remote_cmd, so its remote destructive commands show as 133712 until the hook is updated.
notes_zh: 記錄的內容：誰（作業系統帳號、工作階段 ID、子代理）、在哪裡（主機、工作目錄、權限模式）、做了什麼（工具；shell 指令記錄指令內容，最多 2,000 字元；檔案工具記錄路徑；網頁工具記錄網址）。不記錄檔案內容、指令輸出與提示詞。

機密：hook 在寫入前會把指令裡的密碼、token、金鑰換成 ***（DB_PASSWORD= 這類變數、--password 與 mysql 的 -p 這類選項、網址與 curl -u 裡的帳號:密碼、Authorization 與 Cookie 標頭、私鑰區塊，以及 GitHub、GitLab、Slack、AWS、Google、JWT 的 token 格式）。它無法認得每一支程式的語法：寫在 heredoc 或位置參數裡的密碼可能留下。記錄與告警都要當成機密資料保護。
hook 在呼叫執行前（PreToolUse）記錄，所以之後被使用者或權限系統拒絕的呼叫也會留下：告警代表的是「嘗試」。
hook 永遠不會擋下任何動作：不輸出任何東西、一律以 0 結束、任何錯誤都安靜放棄；主機上沒有 /var/log/jt-ai-agent/actions.log 時什麼都不做。
要強制啟用就放在 managed settings（/etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json）：那裡的 hook 使用者關不掉，disableAllHooks 也關不掉。放在使用者自己的 ~/.claude/settings.json 只對那個使用者有效，而且他自己可以拿掉。
記錄檔對所有本機帳號開放寫入（權限 0622），讓以一般帳號執行的代理也能寫。所以本機帳號可以附加偽造的行；已被 Wazuh 讀走的內容會留在 Wazuh。hook 與 managed settings 的變更由檔案完整性回報（133722、133723）。
規則比對的是高風險指令最常見的寫法，指令總有辦法改寫成比對不到的形式。只要 hook 有在跑，每一個指令的 level 3 記錄是避不開的那一層。
沒有 hook 機制的代理（Aider、Windsurf、Cline、Continue、直接執行的本機模型……）不在範圍內；任何工具只要把同樣格式的 JSON 寫進這個記錄檔，就會以同樣方式讀取。

1.1：支援 Codex 與 opencode。hook 加上 --agent codex|opencode，把它們的工具名稱對應成 Claude Code 的名稱：Codex 的 apply_patch 變成 Edit（只新增檔案時是 Write），只記被修改的路徑、不記補丁內容；opencode 的 bash／read／write／edit 變成 Bash／Read／Write／Edit。所以同一組規則涵蓋三種代理，jt_ai.agent 標出是哪一個，原本的名稱保留在 jt_ai.tool_raw。Codex 由 /etc/codex/requirements.toml 的受管理 hooks 呼叫，opencode 經套件的外掛（/etc/opencode/plugins/）呼叫。修改 Codex 或 opencode 的設定與外掛視為「代理修改自己的設定」（133713／133714，也會抓到以 --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust 或 --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox 啟動 codex），/etc/codex 與 opencode 外掛也納入竄改規則與檔案完整性監控。Codex 由伺服器端執行的網頁搜尋不經過 PreToolUse，所以不會被記錄。

1.2：記錄實際操作的人與專案（sudo 前的帳號 real_user、login_user、SSH 來源 ssh_from、git 專案與分支）、權限請求（133736）、失敗的呼叫（133737）、工作階段結束，MCP 拆成伺服器與工具（mcp_server、mcp_tool），指令中被移除的帳密會標記（133735）。新的行為規則：用 curl／wget 上傳本機檔案（133724）、檔案分享／穿隧／帶外服務（133725）、原始 socket（133726）、雲端／套件庫／其他代理的帳密（133727、133728）、.env（133729，L5）、以 cron、systemd、shell 啟動檔或 authorized_keys 持久化（133730、133731）、清除歷史或記錄、關閉稽核或安全控制（133732，L12）、帳號與權限（133733、133740）、--no-verify（133734）、從公網 SSH 驅動的工作階段（133738）。權限請求與失敗先由 level 0 規則接走，不會再觸發一次偵測規則。支援 macOS（agent 群組的 Darwin 區段）。

1.3：支援 Gemini CLI、Cursor、GitHub Copilot。hook 加上 --agent gemini|cursor|copilot，把它們的事件格式與工具名稱對應成 Claude Code 的（Gemini 的 run_shell_command／read_file／write_file／replace 變成 Bash／Read／Write／Edit，MCP 工具 mcp_<伺服器>_<工具> 變成 mcp__<伺服器>__<工具>；Cursor 的 Shell 變成 Bash、MCP:<工具> 變成 mcp__ 名稱；Copilot 的 bash／view／create／edit 變成 Bash／Read／Write／Edit）。Gemini CLI：hook 放在系統設定 /etc/gemini-cli/settings.json（macOS 為 /Library/Application Support/GeminiCli/），系統設定會蓋過使用者與專案設定（hooksConfig.disabled 例外，見 1.5.3）。Cursor：企業 hook /etc/cursor/hooks.json（macOS 為 /Library/Application Support/Cursor/hooks.json）；Cursor 的「執行前」hook 都是權限 hook，回答格式不對就會擋下呼叫，所以套件用 postToolUse 與 postToolUseFailure：每一個 Cursor 呼叫在執行後立即記成一筆 PostToolUse，被拒絕或失敗的帶 failed 與 error，偵測規則一樣看得到被拒絕的嘗試。Copilot（Copilot CLI；GitHub 沒有說明 VS Code 的代理模式會不會讀 policy.d，要在 VS Code 實際確認）：政策 hook /etc/github-copilot/policy.d/jt-ai-agent.json；hook 失敗時 Copilot 會拒絕 preToolUse 的呼叫，所以指令最後加上 exit 0，而且這三種代理 hook 一律輸出 {}（不做決定）。VS Code 已淘汰的 Local harness 不讀系統層的 hook，不在範圍內。Cursor 回報的使用者電子郵件記在 jt_ai.account。新增：修改 Gemini、Cursor、Copilot 或專案 hook 的設定視為「代理修改自己的設定」（133713／133714，也會抓 gemini --yolo、copilot --allow-all-tools、cursor-agent --force），代理修改 VS Code 設定（133741，L6：那裡可以開啟自動核准，CVE-2025-53773）或從 shell 動到自動核准設定（133742，L8），Gemini、Copilot、Cursor 的登入檔視為帳密（133727／133728），Cursor 的 Delete 工具算檔案變更。

1.4：同一個工作階段（jt_ai.session）內的連續行為：先讀帳密（133711、133715、133727-133729），15 分鐘內再上傳檔案或使用穿隧、檔案分享服務，為 level 13（133745），這是被提示注入的代理外洩資料的樣子；十分鐘內四個以上破壞性指令為 level 12（133746），代表失控的工作階段。沒有工作階段 ID 的記錄不做關聯。133725 加上更多穿隧服務（localhost.run、serveo、pinggy、bore、localtunnel）。在 jt-alert-digest.conf 設 daily_groups = ai_agent，每日摘要就會多一段 AI 代理統計。盤點（jt-ai-agent-inventory.py，每個 manager 節點每六小時）：依 syscollector 的套件、程序、監聽連接埠與檔案完整性資料庫，不在 ai-agent 群組的主機上有 AI 程式代理為 level 8（133751），在群組裡卻沒有 hook 為 level 7（133752），Aider（沒有 hook 機制）為 level 5（133753），本機模型服務為 level 3（133754），在非迴環位址監聽的為 level 8（133755）：Ollama 與 llama.cpp 的伺服器預設沒有認證。每項發現只報一次、每週提醒一次，消失時再報一次（133756）。套件在 syscollector 下一次套件掃描後就找得到；程序只有在每小時的程序掃描時正在執行才找得到。

1.4.1：依正式機第一次執行修正盤點：監聽的連接埠一直對不到程序（wazuh-db 在 sys_ports 裡把欄位叫 PID）；Proxmox 主機會把非特權 LXC 容器的程序（使用者 100000 以上）當成自己的列出，這些現在略過；Ollama 自己的 llama-server 不再另外報成 llama.cpp 伺服器；認得 vLLM 的引擎程序（VLLM::EngineCore）。133754 不再寫「只在迴環位址監聽」，因為只有套件也會觸發它。

1.5：經 MCP 的瀏覽器自動化（Claude in Chrome、Playwright MCP、Chrome DevTools MCP、Puppeteer MCP）：hook 記下動作（導覽、點選、輸入、填表、截圖、讀頁面、執行 JS、上傳、網路請求、主控台、分頁）、網址、分頁與元素，欄位為 jt_ai.browser_action、url、tab、element；輸入或填寫的文字與 JavaScript 只記長度（text_len、js_len）。規則：每個瀏覽器動作 L3（133747）、在頁面執行 JavaScript L6（133748）、讀取瀏覽器的網路請求或 cookie L6（133749）、在密碼或一次性驗證碼欄位輸入 L5（133758）、把本機檔案上傳 L8（133759，也是「先讀帳密再上傳」的結尾，133745 L13）、開啟內部或管理頁面 L4（133760；迴環位址不算）以及同一工作階段之後在頁面執行 JavaScript 或輸入密碼 L8（133761）。另外：代理修改自己的 MCP 伺服器（133762 指令、133763 檔案，L8）、讀取瀏覽器的 cookie 或已存密碼（133765，L10）、網路掃描（133768，L6）、挖礦程式（133769，L10）、修改 CI/CD 流程（133770，L5）、從 shell 截圖或讀剪貼簿（133771，L5）、新增 git 遠端或推送到指令列上的位址（133772，L6）、/var/ossec/etc 或 /Library/Ossec/etc 底下 Wazuh agent 自己的設定視為竄改稽核（133720／133721，L12），以及以關閉所有權限確認的方式啟動 Claude Code 與其他代理同等看待（133714）。參數格式依各工具的文件，受稽核的主機上還沒有實際用過這些工具。

1.5.1：133720（L12）只要指令裡出現 /var/ossec/etc 就命中，所以代理用 heredoc 寫文件、在那裡建立其他檔案、經 SSH 管理 manager 都會出現 L12（正式機第一天就遇到）。現在只有在本機以 shell 修改 Wazuh agent 自己的 ossec.conf、local_internal_options.conf、client.keys 才算，改為 133773（L10），heredoc 與經 ssh 的指令不算；以 Edit／Write 工具改這些檔案仍是 133721（L12）。

1.5.2：opencode 的 MCP 工具名稱是「伺服器_工具」，不是 mcp__伺服器__工具，所以它的 MCP 呼叫只記成原始名稱、沒有對到任何規則。hook 現在從 opencode 的設定（系統與使用者的 opencode.json／jsonc、OPENCODE_CONFIG 與專案的設定）讀出伺服器名稱，把這些呼叫記成 mcp__伺服器__工具並帶 mcp_server、mcp_tool，與 Claude Code 相同（133707）。opencode 2.x 的 Code Mode（execute 工具：呼叫 MCP 工具與發 HTTP 請求的 JavaScript）記成 CodeMode，只記腳本長度（133774，L3）；它呼叫的每個工具另外各記一行。看板：代理程式、AI 代理、事件、工具、主機、帳號、SSH 目的地、MCP 伺服器的表格旁多一張圖；「觸發最多的規則」的說明改為該列 AI 代理的那一句。

1.5.3：Gemini CLI 會把使用者與專案設定裡的 hooksConfig.disabled 併入系統設定的清單（合併方式 UNION），所以使用者可以用 /hooks disable，或直接編輯 ~/.gemini/settings.json、<專案>/.gemini/settings.json 關掉稽核 hook。現在每次有受稽核的工作階段開始（任何代理），hook 會讀這兩個檔，若 hook 在那裡被停用或整個 hooks 被關掉，就記下是哪個檔、哪個設定（jt_ai.gemini_hook_off；檔案的其他內容一概不記，那裡可能有 MCP 伺服器的 token）：規則 133775，L10。專案的設定檔只有在該專案（或其子目錄）開始工作階段時才看得到。Copilot：GitHub 沒有說明 VS Code 的代理模式會不會讀 policy.d，請在 VS Code 實際確認後再倚賴。

1.5.4：盤點腳本（jt-ai-agent-inventory.py 1.1）補上只用 Gemini 的人：它從本節點的告警記住每台主機上每種代理最後一次出現的時間，主機在群組裡、hook 也在，Gemini CLI、Claude Code 或 Codex 的程序在 24 小時內啟動，啟動後卻一行記錄都沒有，就是規則 133776（L7）。常駐但閒置的服務（opencode serve）與只在使用時才記錄的 Cursor 程式不列入判斷。

1.6：可以記錄使用者的提示，伺服器端沒開啟就不記：agent 群組的 jt-ai-agent.conf 裡的設定「prompts」（jt-wazuh-mgr 本套件的「設定」）可選 off、local（提示去掉密碼後留在主機的 /var/log/jt-ai-agent/prompts.log，只有 root 讀得到；稽核記錄只帶長度與雜湊）或 wazuh（稽核記錄另帶前 2,000 字）。manager 把檔案送到群組的每台主機；root 的排程（jt-ai-agent-hook.py --sync-config，每五分鐘）把它複製到 /etc/jt-ai-agent/config 給每個使用者的 hook 讀取，並記錄每次變更（規則 133779，L5）。規則 133777（一則提示，L3）與 133778（提示裡貼了密碼或 token，L8：它已經送到 AI 服務商）。適用 Claude Code（UserPromptSubmit）、Codex（UserPromptSubmit）、Gemini CLI（BeforeAgent）與 Copilot（userPromptSubmitted）；Cursor 的提示 hook 可能擋下提示，不納入，opencode 尚未支援。

1.6（Windows，BETA）：Windows 版 PowerShell hook（jt-ai-agent-hook.ps1，只需 Windows PowerShell 5.1）與安裝程式（jt-ai-agent-install.ps1），支援 Windows 上的 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Cursor 與 GitHub Copilot，含提示記錄；記錄行帶 "platform":"windows" 與 "hook":"ps1-beta"。已在 Windows 11（Windows PowerShell 5.1）以各代理文件記載的 hook 輸入實測，但還沒在 Windows 上真正的代理工作階段中執行過（尤其 Codex 與 Copilot 的 Windows hook 是依其文件與原始碼）。每次呼叫都要啟動 PowerShell，約一到兩秒。Windows 上的 opencode 尚未支援。Windows 專用規則：133780（以指令改了 hook、記錄、排程工作或受管理設定，L12）、133781（清除事件記錄，或關閉 Defender、稽核、防火牆、備份，L12）、133782（常駐：排程工作、服務、Run 機碼、啟動資料夾、WMI、PowerShell profile，L10）、133783（本機使用者與群組、UAC，L10）；133712（破壞性指令）與 133715（讀帳密）也會看 Windows 指令，133721 至 133723 也涵蓋 Windows 路徑。盤點目前還不判斷 Windows 主機（不會對它們發 hook_missing 或 silent）。

1.6.1：兩個 hook 只有在不是正式安裝的那份（/usr/local/lib/jt-ai-agent、C:\Program Files\jt-ai-agent，也就是各代理的受管理設定所執行的）時，才讀 JT_AI_AGENT_LOG、JT_AI_AGENT_PROMPT_LOG、JT_AI_AGENT_CONFIG：hook 以使用者身分執行，否則使用者可以自己設定這些變數，讓提示記錄失效或把稽核記錄寫到別處，而且不會留下任何記錄。Windows 的 hook 與安裝程式改向 Windows 查詢 ProgramData 與 Program Files 的位置，不再讀同名的環境變數。本來就取自使用者環境的欄位（sudo 前的帳號、SSH 來源位址），可信度只和那個環境一樣。macOS 的提示步驟寫明 newsyslog 設定檔。

1.6.2（Windows，BETA）：安裝程式新增 -Agents（只設定指定的代理）與 -Prompts（在 manager 沒有派送設定的主機上直接設定提示記錄）；新增 jt-ai-agent-uninstall.ps1 與 jt-ai-agent-check.ps1。VS Code 的 GitHub Copilot 與 Copilot CLI 共用同一套執行環境與 hook 格式，會載入全系統的政策 hook（C:\ProgramData\GitHub\Copilot\policy.d），依 GitHub 文件，使用者不能用 disableAllHooks 關掉這一層；VS Code 的 hook 仍是預覽功能，尚未在 VS Code 本身實測。可搭配 VS Code 的企業政策 ChatAllowManagedHooksOnly 與 ChatApprovedAccountOrganizations。Visual Studio（不是 VS Code）與 JetBrains 的 Copilot 官方文件沒有支援 hook。

1.6.3：hook 另外記下 ssh 送到遠端執行的那段指令（jt_ai.remote_cmd，已遮蔽密碼），規則 133716（把破壞性指令送到其他主機，L12）改為只看那一段：像 "ssh host 'systemctl start x'; shred -u key" 裡的 shred 是在本機執行，維持 133712（L10）。1.6.3 之前的 hook 不會送 remote_cmd，在 hook 更新前，送到遠端的破壞性指令只會是 133712。

setup.title: Install the pack and reload the ruleset
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並重新載入規則集
setup.body:
1. Install from this page.
2. Rules tab → Reload Ruleset (on a cluster this reloads every node).
setup.body_zh:
1. 在本頁安裝。
2. 到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」（叢集會重載所有節點）。
setup.verify: Rules tab → search 133700 shows the rules.
setup.verify_zh: 在「規則」分頁搜尋 133700 可以看到這組規則。

setup.title: Put the host in the agent group "ai-agent"
setup.title_zh: 把主機加入 agent 群組「ai-agent」
setup.body:
Add every host where people run AI coding agents to the group "ai-agent" (Groups tab). The group collects the audit log with the pack's prefix, watches the hook and the managed settings, and delivers jt-ai-agent-hook.py and jt-ai-agent.logrotate to /var/ossec/etc/shared/ on the host.

If the host's own ossec.conf already reads /var/log/jt-ai-agent/actions.log, remove that block: the logcollector keeps one definition only.
setup.body_zh:
把每一台有人在跑 AI 程式代理的主機加入群組「ai-agent」（「群組」分頁）。群組會以套件的前置字串收集稽核記錄、監看 hook 與 managed settings，並把 jt-ai-agent-hook.py 與 jt-ai-agent.logrotate 送到主機的 /var/ossec/etc/shared/。

如果主機自己的 ossec.conf 已經讀 /var/log/jt-ai-agent/actions.log，請拿掉那一段：logcollector 只保留一份定義。
setup.verify: Groups tab → ai-agent → the host is listed and synced.
setup.verify_zh: 「群組」分頁 → ai-agent → 看得到該主機，而且是 synced。

setup.title: Install the hook and create the log (as root on the host)
setup.title_zh: 安裝 hook 並建立記錄檔（在主機上以 root 執行）
setup.body:
install -D -m 0755 -o root -g root /var/ossec/etc/shared/jt-ai-agent-hook.py /usr/local/lib/jt-ai-agent/jt-ai-agent-hook.py
install -d -m 0755 /var/log/jt-ai-agent
install -m 0622 /dev/null /var/log/jt-ai-agent/actions.log
install -m 0644 /var/ossec/etc/shared/jt-ai-agent.logrotate /etc/logrotate.d/jt-ai-agent

The hook needs python3 (standard library only). It is run from /usr/local/lib, not from the shared directory, which the Wazuh manager can rewrite.
setup.body_zh:
install -D -m 0755 -o root -g root /var/ossec/etc/shared/jt-ai-agent-hook.py /usr/local/lib/jt-ai-agent/jt-ai-agent-hook.py
install -d -m 0755 /var/log/jt-ai-agent
install -m 0622 /dev/null /var/log/jt-ai-agent/actions.log
install -m 0644 /var/ossec/etc/shared/jt-ai-agent.logrotate /etc/logrotate.d/jt-ai-agent

hook 需要 python3（只用標準函式庫）。執行的是 /usr/local/lib 裡的副本，不是共享目錄裡的那份（Wazuh manager 可以改寫共享目錄）。
setup.verify: echo '{"hook_event_name":"SessionStart","session_id":"test","cwd":"/tmp"}' | /usr/local/lib/jt-ai-agent/jt-ai-agent-hook.py; tail -1 /var/log/jt-ai-agent/actions.log shows the test line, and rule 133705 fires on the manager.
setup.verify_zh: 執行 echo '{"hook_event_name":"SessionStart","session_id":"test","cwd":"/tmp"}' | /usr/local/lib/jt-ai-agent/jt-ai-agent-hook.py 之後，tail -1 /var/log/jt-ai-agent/actions.log 看得到這一行，manager 上出現規則 133705。

setup.title: Turn the hook on for every Claude Code user (managed settings)
setup.title_zh: 對所有 Claude Code 使用者啟用 hook（managed settings）
setup.verify: Start Claude Code, run any command, then tail -2 /var/log/jt-ai-agent/actions.log shows a SessionStart and a PreToolUse line; the manager shows 133705 and 133702.
setup.verify_zh: 啟動 Claude Code、執行任一指令後，tail -2 /var/log/jt-ai-agent/actions.log 看得到 SessionStart 與 PreToolUse 兩行；manager 上出現 133705 與 133702。

setup.title: Codex: enable the hook for every user (managed hooks)
setup.title_zh: Codex：對所有使用者啟用 hook（受管理的 hooks）
setup.body: Codex (0.160 or later, hooks are a stable feature) runs the same hook. Put it in Codex's system requirements file, /etc/codex/requirements.toml (root, 0644): managed hooks there need no trust review and users cannot turn them off, while their own hooks keep working. If the file already has a [features] or [hooks] table, merge these keys into it instead of appending. Codex reads the file when a session starts.
setup.body_zh: Codex（0.160 以後，hooks 是穩定功能）執行同一支 hook。放在 Codex 的系統要求檔 /etc/codex/requirements.toml（root、0644）：這裡的受管理 hooks 不需要信任確認、使用者關不掉，使用者自己的 hooks 照常運作。檔案已經有 [features] 或 [hooks] 區段時，把這些鍵合併進去，不要再附加一份。Codex 在工作階段開始時讀這個檔。
setup.code:
cat >> /etc/codex/requirements.toml <<'EOF'
[features]
hooks = true

[hooks]
managed_dir = "/usr/local/lib/jt-ai-agent"

[[hooks.PreToolUse]]
matcher = ".*"
[[hooks.PreToolUse.hooks]]
type = "command"
command = "/usr/local/lib/jt-ai-agent/jt-ai-agent-hook.py --agent codex"
timeout = 5

[[hooks.SessionStart]]
[[hooks.SessionStart.hooks]]
type = "command"
command = "/usr/local/lib/jt-ai-agent/jt-ai-agent-hook.py --agent codex"
timeout = 5
EOF
chmod 0644 /etc/codex/requirements.toml
setup.verify: Start Codex and run any command: tail -2 /var/log/jt-ai-agent/actions.log shows a SessionStart and a PreToolUse line with "agent":"codex"; the manager shows 133705 and 133702.
setup.verify_zh: 啟動 Codex、執行任一指令後，tail -2 /var/log/jt-ai-agent/actions.log 看得到帶 "agent":"codex" 的 SessionStart 與 PreToolUse 兩行；manager 上出現 133705 與 133702。

setup.title: opencode: install the plugin for every user
setup.title_zh: opencode：為所有使用者安裝外掛
setup.body: opencode loads plugins from its system directory /etc/opencode/plugins/ for every user on the host (~/.config/opencode/plugins/ for one user). The pack's plugin works with opencode 2.x and 1.x: before every tool call and when a session is created it hands the call to the same hook (--agent opencode), without waiting for it and without changing anything. Restart opencode (or an opencode serve service) to load it.
setup.body_zh: opencode 會載入系統目錄 /etc/opencode/plugins/ 裡的外掛，對主機上所有使用者生效（只給一個使用者用則放 ~/.config/opencode/plugins/）。套件的外掛支援 opencode 2.x 與 1.x：每次工具呼叫前與建立工作階段時，把資料交給同一支 hook（--agent opencode），不等待結果、不改變任何東西。重新啟動 opencode（或 opencode serve 的服務）後生效。
setup.verify: Run any command in opencode: tail -1 /var/log/jt-ai-agent/actions.log shows a PreToolUse line with "agent":"opencode"; the manager shows 133702.
setup.verify_zh: 在 opencode 執行任一指令後，tail -1 /var/log/jt-ai-agent/actions.log 看得到帶 "agent":"opencode" 的 PreToolUse 一行；manager 上出現 133702。

setup.title: 1.2: also send permission requests, failures and session ends
setup.title_zh: 1.2：一併送出權限請求、失敗與工作階段結束
setup.body_zh:
1.2 在同一支 hook 加上四種事件：PermissionRequest（代理要求允許一次呼叫）、Claude Code 的 PostToolUseFailure（Codex、opencode 用 PostToolUse；hook 只在呼叫失敗時寫一行，且不讀輸出）、SubagentStart、SessionEnd。把它們加在 PreToolUse、SessionStart 旁邊：
- Claude Code 受管理設定："PermissionRequest"、"PostToolUseFailure" 加 "matcher": "*"，"SubagentStart"、"SessionEnd" 不加 matcher，都執行同一個指令；
- Codex /etc/codex/requirements.toml：[[hooks.PermissionRequest]]、[[hooks.PostToolUse]] 加 matcher ".*"，以及 [[hooks.SubagentStart]]、[[hooks.SessionEnd]]，都執行帶 --agent codex 的 hook；
- opencode：安裝 1.2 的外掛（它自己回報失敗與權限請求）。
macOS 上 Claude Code 的檔案是 /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json，opencode 的系統外掛在 /Library/Application Support/opencode/plugins/；記錄輪替用 newsyslog（/etc/newsyslog.d/jt-ai-agent.conf："/var/log/jt-ai-agent/actions.log 622 8 5000 * J"）。agent 群組有 Darwin 區段收記錄並監控這些路徑的完整性。
setup.verify: Deny a permission prompt in Claude Code: the log shows a PermissionRequest line and the manager shows 133736; a failing command shows 133737.
setup.verify_zh: 在 Claude Code 拒絕一次權限確認：記錄出現 PermissionRequest，manager 出現 133736；失敗的指令出現 133737。

setup.title: 1.3: Gemini CLI, Cursor and GitHub Copilot
setup.body_zh:
同一支 hook，放在各代理的系統層設定（root，0644；檔案已存在時合併進去，不要整個取代），對主機上所有使用者生效。

Gemini CLI：/etc/gemini-cli/settings.json（macOS：/Library/Application Support/GeminiCli/settings.json）。系統設定會蓋過使用者與專案設定，但 hooksConfig.disabled 例外：Gemini 會合併三者，所以使用者可以用 /hooks disable 關掉這個 hook（1.5.3 與 1.5.4 起會告警，規則 133775 與 133776）。內容同英文版。

Cursor：/etc/cursor/hooks.json（macOS：/Library/Application Support/Cursor/hooks.json）。只用「執行後」的事件：Cursor 的「執行前」hook 回答格式不符時會擋下呼叫。內容同英文版。

GitHub Copilot（Copilot CLI。GitHub 的文件沒有說明 VS Code 的代理模式會不會讀 policy.d：安裝後在 VS Code 代理模式跑一個無害的指令，記錄裡出現 "agent":"copilot" 那行才算有稽核，沒有就表示 VS Code 不在範圍內）：/etc/github-copilot/policy.d/jt-ai-agent.json（macOS 路徑相同）。每個事件一筆，各自帶事件名稱；最後的 exit 0 不能省，hook 失敗時 Copilot 會拒絕 preToolUse 的呼叫。內容同英文版。

之後開新的工作階段（執行中的仍用舊設定）。
setup.verify: Start a session in the agent and run one harmless command: a line with "agent":"gemini" (or cursor, copilot) appears in /var/log/jt-ai-agent/actions.log and as rule 133702 or 133705 in Wazuh.
setup.verify_zh: 在該代理開一個工作階段、執行一個無害的指令：/var/log/jt-ai-agent/actions.log 出現 "agent":"gemini"（或 cursor、copilot）的一行，Wazuh 出現規則 133702 或 133705。

setup.title: 1.4: inventory of unaudited agents and model servers (every manager node)
setup.title_zh: 1.4：未受稽核的代理與模型服務盤點（每個 manager 節點）
setup.body: Installing or updating schedules jt-ai-agent-inventory.py every six hours on this node. Each node checks only the agents connected to it, so on a cluster copy the script to every worker and create the same schedule there, as below. It only reads wazuh-db (SELECT) and needs no Internet access. Run --list once to see what it finds before the first scheduled run.
setup.body_zh: 安裝或更新時會在本節點排程每六小時執行 jt-ai-agent-inventory.py。每個節點只檢查連到自己的 agent，所以叢集要把腳本複製到每個 worker，並在那裡建立同樣的排程，如下所示。它只讀 wazuh-db（SELECT），不需要連外。第一次排程執行前，先用 --list 看它會找到什麼。
setup.verify: --list prints one line per finding (agent, finding, tool, evidence). After a run, rules 133751-133755 show the findings.
setup.verify_zh: --list 每項發現印一行（agent、發現、工具、依據）。執行後規則 133751-133755 會出現這些發現。

setup.title: 1.6: users' prompts (off unless turned on)
setup.body:
Prompts are not recorded unless the setting "prompts" is changed (this pack's Settings in jt-wazuh-mgr, or the file etc/shared/ai-agent/jt-ai-agent.conf on the manager): off (default), local (the prompt stays on the host in /var/log/jt-ai-agent/prompts.log, root only; Wazuh gets the length and a hash) or wazuh (also the first 2,000 characters in Wazuh). Rules: 133777 (a prompt, L3), 133778 (a password or token in a prompt, L8), 133779 (the setting changed on a host, L5).

On each host (root), so that the setting can reach every user's hook and prompts can be stored:
install -m 0622 /dev/null /var/log/jt-ai-agent/prompts.log
install -m 0644 /var/ossec/etc/shared/jt-ai-agent.logrotate /etc/logrotate.d/jt-ai-agent
install -m 0644 /var/ossec/etc/shared/jt-ai-agent-config.cron /etc/cron.d/jt-ai-agent-config
/usr/local/lib/jt-ai-agent/jt-ai-agent-hook.py --sync-config
(macOS: /Library/Ossec/etc/shared/com.jasontools.jt-ai-agent-config.plist to /Library/LaunchDaemons/, then launchctl load -w that file; rotate prompts.log with newsyslog: add the line "/var/log/jt-ai-agent/prompts.log 622 90 5000 * J" to /etc/newsyslog.d/jt-ai-agent.conf, next to the actions.log line.)

Add the prompt event to each agent's hooks, next to the existing ones and running the same command: Claude Code managed settings "UserPromptSubmit" (no matcher); Codex requirements.toml [[hooks.UserPromptSubmit]] with --agent codex; Gemini CLI "BeforeAgent" with --agent gemini; Copilot policy "userPromptSubmitted" with --agent copilot --event userPromptSubmitted (and "; exit 0"). Cursor is left out: its prompt hook blocks the prompt when the answer is not exactly what it expects. opencode is not covered yet. With the setting off, the hook writes nothing for these events.
setup.body_zh:
除非改了設定「prompts」（jt-wazuh-mgr 本套件的「設定」，或 manager 上的 etc/shared/ai-agent/jt-ai-agent.conf），提示不會被記錄：off（預設）、local（提示留在主機的 /var/log/jt-ai-agent/prompts.log，只有 root 讀得到；Wazuh 只收到長度與雜湊）、wazuh（另外把前 2,000 字送進 Wazuh）。規則：133777（一則提示，L3）、133778（提示裡有密碼或 token，L8）、133779（主機上的設定變了，L5）。

在每台主機（root）執行，讓設定能傳到每個使用者的 hook，並能保存提示：
install -m 0622 /dev/null /var/log/jt-ai-agent/prompts.log
install -m 0644 /var/ossec/etc/shared/jt-ai-agent.logrotate /etc/logrotate.d/jt-ai-agent
install -m 0644 /var/ossec/etc/shared/jt-ai-agent-config.cron /etc/cron.d/jt-ai-agent-config
/usr/local/lib/jt-ai-agent/jt-ai-agent-hook.py --sync-config
（macOS：把 /Library/Ossec/etc/shared/com.jasontools.jt-ai-agent-config.plist 放到 /Library/LaunchDaemons/，再 launchctl load -w；prompts.log 以 newsyslog 輪替：在 /etc/newsyslog.d/jt-ai-agent.conf 的 actions.log 那行旁邊加上 "/var/log/jt-ai-agent/prompts.log 622 90 5000 * J"。）

在各代理的 hooks 加上提示事件，放在既有項目旁邊、執行同一個指令：Claude Code 受管理設定 "UserPromptSubmit"（不加 matcher）；Codex requirements.toml 的 [[hooks.UserPromptSubmit]]（--agent codex）；Gemini CLI "BeforeAgent"（--agent gemini）；Copilot 政策 "userPromptSubmitted"（--agent copilot --event userPromptSubmitted，結尾 "; exit 0"）。Cursor 不加：它的提示 hook 回答不完全符合預期就會擋下提示。opencode 尚未支援。設定為 off 時，hook 對這些事件不寫任何東西。
setup.verify: With the setting on "local": send one prompt; tail -1 /var/log/jt-ai-agent/actions.log shows a UserPromptSubmit line with prompt_len and prompt_sha, prompts.log has the prompt, and the manager shows rule 133777. Changing the setting shows rule 133779 for each host within about ten minutes.
setup.verify_zh: 設定改成 local 後送出一則提示：tail -1 /var/log/jt-ai-agent/actions.log 有一行 UserPromptSubmit（帶 prompt_len、prompt_sha），prompts.log 有該提示，manager 出現規則 133777。改設定後約十分鐘內，每台主機出現規則 133779。

setup.title: Windows (beta): install the PowerShell hook (as administrator on the host)
setup.title_zh: Windows（beta）：安裝 PowerShell hook（在主機上以系統管理員執行）
setup.body:
BETA. Put the host in the agent group "ai-agent" first; the group delivers jt-ai-agent-hook.ps1 and jt-ai-agent-install.ps1 to the Wazuh agent's shared directory. Then, in an elevated Windows PowerShell:
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\Program Files (x86)\ossec-agent\shared\jt-ai-agent-install.ps1"

It copies the hook to C:\Program Files\jt-ai-agent, creates C:\ProgramData\jt-ai-agent\actions.log and prompts.log (users may only append to them), adds the hook to the system-wide settings of Claude Code (C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json), Codex (C:\ProgramData\OpenAI\Codex\requirements.toml), Gemini CLI (C:\ProgramData\gemini-cli\settings.json), Cursor (C:\ProgramData\Cursor\hooks.json) and GitHub Copilot (C:\ProgramData\GitHub\Copilot\policy.d\jt-ai-agent.json), merging into existing files and leaving a backup (*.jt-bak-<time>) next to each, and registers the scheduled task jt-ai-agent-config (SYSTEM, at start-up and every five minutes) that copies the prompt setting. Run it again after updating the pack. To try it without touching the agents: add -TestRoot C:\some\folder. -Agents copilot (or claude-code,codex,gemini,cursor) sets up only those agents; -Prompts off|local|wazuh sets the prompt setting on a host the manager does not deliver it to. jt-ai-agent-check.ps1 prints a report (installed files, the Copilot policy events, the prompt setting, log permissions, counts and the last audit lines); jt-ai-agent-uninstall.ps1 removes the hook from every agent's settings, keeping other hooks and leaving backups, and keeps the logs unless -RemoveLogs.

The hook needs only Windows PowerShell 5.1 (every Windows 10 and 11 has it). It is started for every call, which takes about one to two seconds; its timeout is 10 seconds. Restart running agent sessions afterwards.
setup.body_zh:
BETA。先把主機加入 agent 群組「ai-agent」；群組會把 jt-ai-agent-hook.ps1 與 jt-ai-agent-install.ps1 送到 Wazuh agent 的共享目錄。接著在以系統管理員身分開啟的 Windows PowerShell 執行：
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\Program Files (x86)\ossec-agent\shared\jt-ai-agent-install.ps1"

它會把 hook 複製到 C:\Program Files\jt-ai-agent；建立 C:\ProgramData\jt-ai-agent\actions.log 與 prompts.log（使用者只能附加）；把 hook 加進 Claude Code（C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json）、Codex（C:\ProgramData\OpenAI\Codex\requirements.toml）、Gemini CLI（C:\ProgramData\gemini-cli\settings.json）、Cursor（C:\ProgramData\Cursor\hooks.json）與 GitHub Copilot（C:\ProgramData\GitHub\Copilot\policy.d\jt-ai-agent.json）的全系統設定，與既有內容合併，並在旁邊留一份備份（*.jt-bak-<時間>）；最後註冊排程工作 jt-ai-agent-config（SYSTEM，開機時與每五分鐘）來複製提示設定。更新套件後再執行一次。想先試試而不動到各代理：加上 -TestRoot C:\某個資料夾。-Agents copilot（或 claude-code,codex,gemini,cursor）只設定這些代理；-Prompts off|local|wazuh 在 manager 沒有派送設定的主機上直接設定提示記錄。jt-ai-agent-check.ps1 印出報告（安裝的檔案、Copilot 政策讀到的事件、提示設定、記錄檔權限、筆數與最後幾筆記錄）；jt-ai-agent-uninstall.ps1 從各代理的設定移除 hook（保留其他 hook、留下備份），記錄檔預設保留，加 -RemoveLogs 才刪除。

hook 只需要 Windows PowerShell 5.1（Windows 10、11 都有）。每次呼叫都要啟動一次，約一到兩秒；逾時設為 10 秒。裝完後要重新啟動正在執行的代理工作階段。
setup.verify: The installer ends with a self-test line from C:\ProgramData\jt-ai-agent\actions.log ("platform":"windows","hook":"ps1-beta"), and rule 133705 fires on the manager node that handles the host. Get-ScheduledTask jt-ai-agent-config shows the task.
setup.verify_zh: 安裝程式最後會印出 C:\ProgramData\jt-ai-agent\actions.log 的自我測試行（"platform":"windows","hook":"ps1-beta"），處理這台主機的 manager 節點出現規則 133705。Get-ScheduledTask jt-ai-agent-config 看得到排程工作。

agent_group.name: ai-agent
agent_group.description: Collects the AI coding agent audit log with the pack's prefix, watches the hook, the opencode plugin and the managed settings of Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor and Copilot, and delivers the hook, the opencode plugin, the logrotate file and, for Windows (beta), the PowerShell hook and its installer

scripts.name: jt-ai-agent-inventory.py
scripts.description: Finds AI coding agents on hosts outside the ai-agent group, hosts in the group without the hook, and local model servers listening on the network, from the inventory syscollector keeps on this node

items.title: Record users' prompts to AI agents
items.title_zh: 記錄使用者給 AI 代理的提示

choice_titles.local: On the host only (Wazuh gets the length and a hash)
choice_titles.wazuh: On the host and in Wazuh (first 2,000 characters)

choice_titles_zh.local: 只留在主機（Wazuh 只收到長度與雜湊）
choice_titles_zh.wazuh: 留在主機並送進 Wazuh（前 2,000 字）

items.help: Applies to every host in the agent group ai-agent within about ten minutes (the manager delivers the file, the hosts pick it up every five minutes), and each change is reported (rule 133779). Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Copilot; not Cursor or opencode. Passwords and tokens are always replaced with ***. Prompts often carry personal and customer data: tell the people concerned before turning this on.
items.help_zh: 約十分鐘內套用到 ai-agent 群組的所有主機（manager 送出檔案，主機每五分鐘讀取一次），每次變更都會告警（規則 133779）。適用 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Copilot，Cursor 與 opencode 不適用。密碼與 token 一律換成 ***。提示常含個資與客戶資料，開啟前請先告知相關人員。
